title: WTY Monitors Meeting
description: Interested in being a Monitor at White Tantric Yoga® (WTY)? A WTY Monitor must have attended at least one day of WTY, wear white clothing and a white head covering, and wear the Monitor ID marker. Monitors receive the same benefits of WTY as if they were doing the meditations with a partner. Come learn more about this important role!
